title: The Walk
description: A morning ritual. A growl at an empty horizon. Two red lights in the dust.

title: The Chase
description: Something with six wheels comes out of the dust. Run for the hatch.

title: Pending
description: The transfer home won't confirm. The nodes go dark. Wei knows what to do.

title: gm from Mars
description: Sunrise over the solar farm. Breakfast from the ETH bowl. Wei wakes the colonist and heads for the hatch.

title: Listen to the dog, Cobie
description: The rover's scanner locks on: TARGET: WEI. Wei tries to warn the colonist. Nobody listens. Outside, something waits by the hatch.
